description:
Windows-native menu bar app for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code usage stats.

Win-CodexBar is a Windows-native desktop app for viewing AI coding-tool usage stats from a small Tauri shell.
Windows port of upstream CodexBar 0.60.4 to 0.70.0: 139 pull requests, including six community contributions, covering new providers (Hyper, GitKraken AI, Bifrost, Atlas Cloud, Aixy, llmman, DevPass, xKiro, Raycast, Vercel AI Gateway, Sakana), ElevenLabs, StepFun, LiteLLM and Mistral updates, cost reporting periods, OpenAI daily usage charts, quota burndown, compact Overview parity, provider detail visibility, reset observations, running-version display, plus privacy, tray, CLI and reliability fixes.
